all_features.headline: Edit photos effortlessly <0>for free</0>
all_features.copy: Easily crop, resize, add frames or text, and customize with graphics or stickers, all in one click.

remix.headline: Edit photos effortlessly <0>for free</0>
remix.copy: Do more with your photos, from the artsy DuoTone and Trippy effects to subtle photo adjustments and more.

touchup.headline: Touch up photos effortlessly <0>for free</0>
touchup.copy: Adjust low lighting, bring up contrast, boost saturation, fix blurry photos, and more.

further.headline: Take your photos <0>further</0>
further.copy: Add filters, effects, adjustments, or customize with frames, text, or stickers. Edit photos effortlessly.

collage.headline: Stay inspired with <0>photo collage templates</0>
collage.copy: Discover how much more you can do with photos

magic_eraser.headline: Clean up pictures with <0>Magic Eraser</0>
magic_eraser.copy: Brush over or click on distractions to instantly remove them with Canva Pro's Magic Eraser.

transform_with_magic.headline: Transform photos with <0>magic</0>
transform_with_magic.copy: Transform your photos in a click with Canva Pro's Magic Edit.

magic_grab.headline: Fine-tune your <0>focal point</0>
magic_grab.copy: Need to move subjects or tweak elements in your pictures? Say goodbye to endless hours of manual editing with Magic Grab.

expand_instantly.headline: Expand photos instantly—<0>like magic</0>
expand_instantly.copy: Canva's Magic Expand lets you fix awkward framing, save zoomed-in images, or turn a vertical shot into a horizontal one.

erase_clutter.headline: Erase clutter and <0>remove backgrounds</0>
erase_clutter.copy: Brush over or click on distractions to instantly remove them with Canva Pro's Magic Eraser.

add_text.headline: Add Text to a Photo <0>for Free</0>
add_text.copy: Give your snapshots something special! Tell your story and add text to your image using our handy-dandy online text tool.

add_borders.headline: Add borders to your photos for <0>a striking effect</0>
add_borders.copy: Direct attention to your images using Canva's free photo frames and borders. Add photo borders to images for presentations, social media content, or photo portfolios.
add_borders.cta: Add a border to a photo

next_level.headline: Take your video to <0>the next level</0>
next_level.copy: Create professional videos using Canva's drag-and-drop editor with transitions, animations, designer fonts, audio library, and more.

trim_and_split.headline: The free video editor for <0>every creator</0>
trim_and_split.copy: Drag and drop videos, and easily trim, split, and resize clips, all within one editor.

text_and_transitions.headline: The free video editor for <0>every creator</0>
text_and_transitions.copy: Drag and drop videos and easily add text, transitions, graphic elements, and more.

video_background_remover.headline: Remove the background of any video, in <0>just one click</0>
video_background_remover.copy: Video Background Remover allows you to remove the background of any video with just one click—no green screen needed!

beat_sync.headline: Sync your soundtrack with <0>Beat Sync</0>
beat_sync.copy: Ready to drop the beat? Beat Sync on Canva will automatically match your video footage to your soundtrack so you can showcase peak moments and keep your audience tuned in.

automatic_captions.headline: Automatic captions in <0>one click</0>
automatic_captions.copy: Automatically generate video captions to drive engagement and make your content accessible and stream-ready.

crop_videos.headline: Crop videos online <0>for free</0>
crop_videos.copy: Upload any MP4, MOV, WEBM, or MKV file format and crop your video to the right size and aspect ratio.

convert_video_to_gif.headline: Convert your video to GIF online <0>for free</0>
convert_video_to_gif.copy: Cut and splice together shareable reaction clips out of your funniest videos for social media. Upload your MP4 and other video files on Canva's video to GIF converter without losing quality.

popular_music.headline: Popular music at <0>your fingertips</0>
popular_music.copy: Effortlessly add music to your video using Canva. Upload your own tracks or browse through our extensive library of stock audio, sound effects, and popular music.

sound_effects.headline: Level up videos with <0>sound effects</0>
sound_effects.copy: Enhance any video project by adding exciting sound effects. Use SFX that thrill, energize, soothe, and everything in between.

video_enhancer.headline: Nail down an aesthetic look with <0>Video Enhancer</0>
video_enhancer.copy: Enhance your video clips online and transform them into professional-looking videos within minutes.

resize_video_for_instagram.headline: Instantly resize your video <0>for Instagram</0>
resize_video_for_instagram.copy: Fit your existing videos to Instagram's aspect ratios. No need to cut corners—keep the important parts in while optimizing them for IG.
